cards.title: Example: build the first screen
cards.text:
The description is in the words of whoever asked: "build the home page from the mockup, the header and the first screen first".

Markup works in the text: **bold**, `code`, [a link](https://example.com). A line break is a new paragraph. Priority shows as bars: P1 — three red, P2 — two amber, P3 — one grey.

cards.text: What a finished task looks like: in Review it has "What's done" and "How to check" filled in. It moves to Done only after the check — on the board owner's word.
